text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Bill Acheson said he raised his rating on Developers Diversified Realty Corp to buy from outerform.
-- raised the 12-month price to $43 from $40, saying stock is trading at too low a price-earnings ratio. Shares opened up 1/2 to 38-1/8.
-- said the low ratio is due to investor misconception that company, which develops and owns so-called power box shopping centers, will suffer as large retailers continue to consolidate.
-- power box centers are distinguished by having large retail tenants like Toys R Us Inc, or Wal-Mart Stores Inc.
-- said Developers is relatively immune to such mergers because its tenants are number one or two in their markets.
